# Silver Dragon Wyrmling (`monsters:silver-dragon-wyrmling`)
*Medium dragon, lawful good* | **CR** 2 (XP 450; PB +2)
**AC** 17 | **HP** 45 (6d8 + 18) | **Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft.
**STR** 19 (+4) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 17 (+3) | **INT** 12 (+1) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 15 (+2)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +2, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +2
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +4, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +2
**Damage Immunities:** cold
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Blindsight 10 ft., Passive Perception 14
**Languages:** Draconic

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
- **Cold Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
- **Paralyzing Breath.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
